content.title: Begin checkout from the cart
content.description: A shopper with a non-empty basket enters checkout from the cart, sees the available entry paths for an anonymous session, verifies that the checkout summary matches the cart totals, and can leave and return without losing basket contents.
content.value: Keeps the purchase journey reachable and intact at the point where revenue conversion begins.
criteria: From a non-empty cart, checkout entry is visible and clickable.
An anonymous shopper is offered guest checkout and register/login options at checkout.
The checkout order summary matches the cart totals exactly.
Leaving checkout and returning preserves basket contents.

content.title: Review product details and add an item to the cart
content.description: A shopper opens a product detail page to inspect buying information, must satisfy any required option selections before adding, receives confirmation when a valid product is added, and expects the chosen quantity to carry into the cart exactly as entered.
content.summary: Inspect a product and add it correctly.
content.value: Lets shoppers make a buying decision and place the intended item and quantity into the basket without corruption.
criteria: Opening a product from a listing shows product name, price, availability, and a quantity field.
Products with required options cannot be added until the options are selected, and the missing option is identified to the shopper.
Adding a valid product updates the header cart total and shows a success confirmation.
Adding quantity N results in quantity N in the cart, not 1.

content.title: Manage cart contents
content.description: A shopper reviews the cart as the authoritative basket state, sees each added product with its pricing and quantity details, changes quantities with totals recalculated correctly, and can remove the final item into an explicit empty-cart state instead of an error state.
content.summary: Review and edit the cart accurately.
content.value: Protects basket integrity so shoppers can trust prices, quantities, and totals before checkout.
criteria: The cart lists every added product with unit price, quantity, and line total.
Each line total equals unit price times quantity.
Updating quantity recalculates the line total and the order total.
Removing the last item leaves the cart in an explicit empty state, not a broken page.

content.title: Register a shopper account
content.description: A new shopper submits registration details, is blocked on malformed email input or an unticked privacy policy with field-level errors and no account creation, and on valid unique details reaches an account-created confirmation state.
content.value: Enables account-based shopping while preventing invalid or non-compliant registrations.
criteria: Registration rejects a malformed email address and an unticked privacy policy with a field-level error, and does not create the account.
Registration with valid unique details lands on an account-created confirmation.

content.title: Sign in to a shopper account
content.description: A returning shopper authenticates with existing credentials, receives a warning on wrong credentials without disclosure of whether the email exists, and on success sees signed-in account navigation in the header.
content.value: Restores account access securely without leaking account existence.
criteria: Wrong credentials show a warning and do not reveal whether the email exists.
A signed-in shopper sees account navigation "My Account / Logout" in the header.

content.title: Search for a product by name
content.description: A shopper enters a product name from any page, can access the search control in the header on home and category pages, receives structured results for matching terms, receives an explicit no-match message for unsuccessful terms, and can revisit or share the results by URL.
content.value: Helps shoppers quickly reach intended products without browsing through categories.
criteria: The search box is present in the header on the home page and on category pages.
A matching search returns at least one product tile, and each tile shows a product name and a price.
A no-match search shows an explicit "no product matches" style message rather than an empty page or an error.
Search results are reachable via a shareable URL that includes the search term.

content.title: Browse and refine a product category
content.description: A shopper opens a top-level category listing, confirms that products are actually presented, changes the sort order among the supported options, adjusts how many products are shown per page, and switches between grid and list presentation without losing the current product set on screen.
content.summary: Browse a category and change result presentation.
content.value: Supports exploratory shopping by letting shoppers navigate categories and control how listings are displayed.
criteria: A top-level category opens a listing page with a product count or product grid.
The listing offers sort options for price low-high, name A-Z, and rating, and the first product changes when the sort order changes.
The listing offers a "show N per page" control, and choosing a larger value increases the number of rendered tiles.
Switching between grid and list view keeps the same products on screen.

content.title: Switch displayed storefront currency
content.description: A shopper changes the storefront currency and expects displayed prices to update consistently across the site rather than only on the current page.
content.summary: Change displayed prices to another currency.
content.value: Improves price comprehension and trust for shoppers viewing the storefront in different currencies.
criteria: Currency switching updates displayed prices site-wide.

content.title: Subscribe to the storefront newsletter
content.description: A shopper submits an email address to the newsletter or subscribe control, succeeds with a valid email value, and is rejected on an invalid email value instead of being silently accepted.
content.summary: Submit an email for newsletter subscription.
content.value: Supports ongoing marketing reach while preventing obviously invalid subscriber data.
criteria: The newsletter or subscribe control accepts a valid email and rejects an invalid one.
